title: Workflow Run
description: Schema for a Cloudflare Workflows execution record. Tracks the durable execution of the PCRAM regulatory intelligence pipeline. A workflow run is an operational record — it does not constitute regulatory approval. All downstream use still requires human review gates.

workflowRunId.description: Unique identifier for this workflow run instance.

workflowName.description: Name of the workflow that was executed.

status.description: Current execution status of the workflow run.

sourceId.description: Optional regulatory source ID this run was triggered for.

triggerReason.description: Optional reason that triggered this workflow run.

triggeredBy.description: Optional non-PII actor label that triggered the run (role or service name).

steps.description: Ordered list of step execution records for this workflow run.

startedAt.description: UTC timestamp when this step started.

completedAt.description: Optional UTC timestamp when this step completed.

error.description: Optional error message if the step failed.

output.description: Optional step output data (non-regulatory, operational only).

startedAt.description: UTC timestamp when this workflow run started.

completedAt.description: Optional UTC timestamp when this workflow run completed or failed.

snapshotId.description: Optional snapshot ID produced by this run (if snapshotWriterStep completed).

evidencePacketId.description: Optional evidence packet ID produced by this run (if evidenceWriterStep completed).

reviewManifestId.description: Optional review manifest ID associated with this run (if humanReviewGateStep completed).

humanReviewGateStatus.description: Status of the human review gate step for this run.

input.description: Optional workflow input parameters (non-sensitive operational data only).

output.description: Optional workflow output summary (non-sensitive operational data only).
